mapper.select: SELECT rx.*, v.visit_no, d.real_name AS doctor_name FROM prescription rx JOIN medical_visit v ON v.id = rx.visit_id JOIN doctor d ON d.id = rx.doctor_id WHERE v.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY rx.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM prescription_item WHERE prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT dr.*, v.visit_no, d.real_name AS doctor_name FROM diagnosis_record dr JOIN medical_visit v ON v.id = dr.visit_id JOIN doctor d ON d.id = v.doctor_id WHERE v.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY dr.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM diagnosis_record WHERE visit_id = #{visitId} ORDER BY id
